svg.aria-label: How a call flows. AI apps such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex call connector-engine over MCP. The gateway checks each function's permission: off hides it, on runs it with the stored credential, ask waits for your approval in the self-hosted console. Allowed calls reach remote and local MCP servers, REST and gRPC connectors. The gateway also keeps approvals, activity and skills.
